caption: Direct task prediction and history restriction. (a) Measured laser input and next-step targets/predictions at both fast and slow loss. (b) Synthetic iid NARMA10 driving input and actual target, compared separately with the fitted QRC and four-input QELM. Traces are the first 96 scored test rows of the first fresh root, without smoothing or cross-root averaging. (c) Reset/replay with refitted readouts, full-QRC references, QELM(4), and quadratic NARMA controls. Medians and 10th-90th root percentiles use all 24 fresh roots; they are variability, not confidence intervals. Laser roots vary couplings on one reused record; NARMA roots also vary inputs. Errors are test NRMSE relative to training-target SD, not worst-case bounds. Longer replay uses more evolution steps. Exact expectations; no quantum-advantage or identical-cost claim.

independent_verification.scope: Every stored test score and target; saved-readout/channel reconstruction sampled at five fixed rows per fitted model and cell. Direction checks are separate from verification success, not universal superiority or hardware validation.

laser.scope: Coupling variation conditional on one measured record

panels.a: laser input and true next-step forecasting, both fixed loss rates
panels.b: synthetic NARMA10 input and true next-step forecasting, one fresh root
panels.c: controlled reset/refit history restriction, 24-root NRMSE medians and 10th-90th percentiles

replication_specification.scope: fresh input/coupling roots for NARMA; fresh couplings conditional on one reused laser record

scope.claims: exact expectations; no quantum advantage, universal superiority or information floor
scope.controls: all h=4, frozen-readout, persistence, training-mean and candidate outcomes retained
scope.history: reset same QRC and refit readout; increasing replay uses more evolution steps
scope.interval: 10th-90th percentiles of 24 rootwise scores, not confidence intervals
scope.laser: fresh coupling roots conditional on one reused measured record; both rates retained
scope.metric: test RMSE / training-target SD (NRMSE); not worst-case error
scope.narma: fresh independent input and coupling roots; no past targets supplied
scope.traces: first fresh root, first 96 scored rows; no smoothing or cross-root averaging

laser.scope: direct measured-target forecasting; no known worst-case floor; one record

narma.scope: Direct synthetic NARMA10 target; exploratory; exact expectations; not measured data

laser.input_units: unquantized measured laser units; hardware input is train-scaled and quantized

narma.input_units: NARMA recursion drive 0.2*u[t]; hardware receives quantized u[t]
